summary: Stoneridge, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 23, 2026, reporting entry into an employment agreement on September 17, 2026, with Uwe Brandenburg as Global Vice President, Engineering Innovation, effective November 2, 2026. Terms include €320,000 base salary (about $367,168), a 50% target bonus, a $150,000 time-based equity grant vesting over three years, 40% annual LTIP target, €1,500 monthly auto allowance, executive severance and change-in-control provisions. This is a routine executive-hire disclosure, not a special situation; no deal, stake, or board recommendation is involved.
